title: Vegan Tzatziki Salad
description: A refreshing and healthy salad made with tzatziki sauce, citrusy flavors, and mixed greens.

ingredients.name: Mixed greens
ingredients.notes: such as arugula, spinach, and lettuce

instructions: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, sliced red onion, and chopped fresh dill.
In a small bowl, whisk together tzatziki sauce and lemon juice.
Pour the tzatziki dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Thinly slice the cucumber and add it to the salad.
Toss the salad gently to combine and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional fresh dill if desired.
